package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestIndependentOptions(t *testing.T) {
	opt := WithBuildOptions(WithLabel("build"))
	require.True(t, opt.Label.Enabled)
	require.Equal(t, "build", opt.Label.Label)
	require.False(t, opt.Tracing.Enabled)
	WithoutTracing()(opt)
	require.True(t, opt.Tracing.Enabled)
	require.False(t, opt.Tracing.Tracing)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
}
